title: Chantarelle mushroom
body:
The chantarelle mushroom is a type of mushroom that usually grows on the sides of acacia trees. One chantarelle mushroom will sell for exactly $100.

It is characterized by 5 smaller mushrooms growing in a clump with typically 1-3 spawning on each acacia tree. The item is not edible, nor can it be used to fill schematics.

It is reccomended to use a variant of grabber tool to pick these off the tree, as they are quite small and come in bunches together for easy transporting.

These are also based off of the real, (edible!) counterpart! however it has poisionous look-alikes, so be careful.
